title: 喵斯兔v1.5.2更新!
content:
1. 优化候选区分类管理，空分类现在也会显示，并可直接导入谱面。
2. 选择分类和移动分类面板新增正式区 / 候选区切换。
3. 候选区子分类支持重命名、删除和批量删除。
4. 新增“仅未归入子分类”筛选，整理候选区谱面更方便。
5. 查重新增“全部区域”，可同时比较正式区与候选区的重复谱面。
6. 新增联机模组下载支持，可在联机大厅直接跳转并下载 Ensemble 及依赖。
7. 移动分类后会尽量保留当前页。
content_en:
1. Improved Candidate Library category management. Empty categories now appear and can receive imports.
2. Category picker and move-category panels can switch between Custom_Albums and Candidate Library.
3. Candidate subcategories now support rename, delete, and batch delete.
4. Added a filter for candidate charts not assigned to subcategories.
5. Deduplication can now scan all areas together to compare Custom_Albums and Candidate Library.
6. Added online multiplayer mod download support. The online lobby can now jump directly to Ensemble and install its dependencies.
7. Moving charts now keeps the current page when possible.

title: 紧急修复
content:
请在北京时间5月26日23：30以前使用了一键安装自制谱的用户，重新点击一键安装自制谱按键，否则会导致：
[Red]在自定义分组内打出成绩的谱面移出分组后成绩会消失[/Red]
如无影响或在这个时间之后一键安装的用户可忽视这条公告。
content_en:
Users who used 'One-Click Install Custom Charts' before 23:30 (UTC+8) on May 26, please click the button again to reinstall. Otherwise, it will cause:
[Red]Scores achieved on charts within a custom group to disappear after moving the chart out of the group.[/Red]
Users unaffected or who installed after this time can ignore this announcement.
